requirements.text: - Bachelor's degree or above, major in computer science or related technical disciplines.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, developer tooling, quality engineering, or test infrastructure for complex and scalable distributed systems.
- Track record of building tooling or frameworks used by other engineers — not only authoring tests within an existing framework.
- Hands-on authorship of CI/CD pipelines including release-gating logic.
- Demonstrated instinct for spotting repetitive or manual engineering work and replacing it with automation, with measurable results.
- Experience in the Ads domain — auction mechanics, bidding, ranking, attribution, or billing.
- Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering-efficiency tooling, or test infrastructure adopted across a team or org.
- Experience testing or validating large-scale ranking and machine learning infrastructure, including model evaluation, A/B experiment correctness, or online/offline consistency.
- Applied LLM/agent tooling for engineering workflows, including structured-output schema design.
